Export a Sankey (standard or tree-integrated)

save_sankey.Rd

Exports fixed SVG geometry. Standalone HTML retains hover highlighting without embedding the raw R data or dependency bundles. PDF and PNG require rsvg.

Usage

save_sankey(x, file, width = NULL, height = NULL,
  pdf_size = c(11.7, 16.5), pdf_mode = c("fit", "tiles"), selfcontained = TRUE)

Arguments

x

A Sankey htmlwidget (ordinary or tree-integrated).

file

Output path ending in html, svg, pdf, png or rds.

width,height

Optional dimensions: pixels for PNG, points for PDF. PDF values override pdf_size.

pdf_size

Maximum PDF page width and height in inches.

selfcontained

For standard Sankey HTML, create a single self-contained HTML file (requires Pandoc). FALSE uses a dependency folder.

pdf_mode

Fit the complete vector figure on one bounded page, or split it into consecutive vertical tiles. Tiles require qpdf.

Value

Invisibly, the normalized output path.

Details

RDS preserves original statistics and the tree. PDF tiles are continuation viewports and may split labels or ribbons. No statistical analysis is recomputed. Ordinary Sankey (tree_mode="none") supports HTML and RDS directly through save_sankey; SVG, PDF and PNG remain tree-only.
